exposure: Timing of hospital discharge after cesarean section (48 hours vs. 72 hours or more)
cohort: 2031 women who underwent cesarean sections between January 1, 2005 and August 31, 2014.
finding: Early discharge at 48 hours after cesarean section in low-risk women was as safe as later discharge (72 hours or more), with a statistically significant lower readmission rate in the early discharge group.
